# Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR)

> OHCHR is the UN's leading human rights body providing knowledge resources, implementation guidance, and advocacy tools to Member States and stakeholders worldwide.

OHCHR operates the Knowledge Gateway as a central platform for accessing human rights best practices, monitoring mechanisms, and country-specific implementation resources. The organization supports Universal Periodic Review processes, tracks Economic, Social and Cultural Rights, and maintains engagement with security forces and protection mechanisms globally.

## Key Topics

- Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR)
- Universal Periodic Review (UPR)
- Human Rights Council
- Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ESCR)
- National Implementation Mechanisms
- Children's Rights Protection
- Security Forces Engagement
- UN Human Rights Library
- Member State Reporting
- Child Reintegration Programs
- Armed Groups Engagement
- Best Practices Implementation
- Country-Specific Guidance
- Human Rights Advocacy
- UN Security Council Resolution 1612

## Knowledge and Implementation Resources

- [OHCHR Knowledge Gateway](https://knowledgegateway.ohchr.org): Central platform for accessing human rights knowledge, best practices, and implementation resources for Member States

## Country-Specific Programs

- [Children's Rights in Nepal](https://nepal.ohchr.org/en/children.html): Resources on child protection, armed groups engagement and reintegration programs in Nepal
